name: United Nations Security Council (UNSC)
shortDescription: Delegates debate pressing global issues like conflicts, sanctions, peacekeeping missions and counter-terrorism. They aim to pass resolutions through consensus or voting, often navigating complex geopolitical dynamics and negotiations, especially due to the veto power held by permanent members.

name: United Nations Human Rights Council (UNHRC)
shortDescription: Delegates debate topics such as violations of human rights, discrimination, refugee crises and freedom of speech, drafting resolutions that balance human rights protection with the political and cultural sensitivities of different nations. Debate emphasizes diplomacy, compromise and international cooperation.

name: Disarmament and International Security Committee (DISEC)
shortDescription: Delegates debate critical international security threats like nuclear non-proliferation, arms control, cyber warfare and the illicit weapons trade, navigating regional alliances and disarmament treaties under a one-country-one-vote system where every member state has an equal voice and there is no veto.

name: UN Women (UNW)
shortDescription: Delegates draft resolutions aimed at advancing gender equality, combating discrimination and promoting women’s participation in political and social spheres, with an emphasis on international cooperation and policy recommendations to improve the status of women globally.

name: Pakistan National Assembly (PNA)
shortDescription: Discussions in the Pakistan National Assembly focus on Pakistan’s domestic policies, political structure and legislative processes, or on debates over issues like security, economic development and social reform.
